issuer: Capital One, N.A. (Discover, a division of Capital One)
notes: Still sold under the Discover it Cash Back name; the product page is now a Capital One page (Discover Bank merged into Capital One, N.A.). The rewards terms PDF still names Discover Bank (2023).

entitlements.name: 5% rotating quarterly categories
entitlements.limits: Activate each quarter (online, app, email or phone). Up to $1,500 in category purchases per quarter ($75 max bonus); earns from the later of quarter start or activation date. Category set by merchant MCC. Credited within 2 billing periods.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Earn 5% Cashback Bonus on up to $1,500 in different category purchases each quarter, when you activate.

entitlements.name: 1% on all other purchases
entitlements.limits: Unlimited. No rewards on cash advances, balance transfers, deposit-account transfers or Cash at Checkout. Some digital-wallet or third-party payment purchases may not earn if transaction detail is insufficient.
entitlements.source_excerpt: You will earn unlimited 1% Cashback Bonus on all purchases other than Program Purchases.

entitlements.name: First-year Cashback Match
entitlements.limits: New cardholders only. Doubles all cash back earned from approval through day 365, no cap, automatic; added within two billing periods after year one. Excludes rewards processed after the period, statement credits, deposit-account transfers, closed accounts. Promo may end.
entitlements.source_excerpt: We'll match all the cash back you've earned on your credit card from the day your new account is approved through your first 365 days

entitlements.name: 0% intro APR, 15 months
entitlements.limits: 15 months on purchases and balance transfers, then 17.74% to 26.74% variable. Balance transfer fee applies. Eligible new customers.
entitlements.source_excerpt: 0% intro APR for 15 months on purchases and balance transfers; 17.74% to 26.74% variable APR after that; Balance Transfer Fee applies

entitlements.name: $0 fraud liability
entitlements.limits: Covers unauthorized purchases; claims subject to investigation and verification. Not covered if you gave card access to someone.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Unauthorized use and $0 fraud liability claims are subject to investigation and verification.

entitlements.name: Card lock in app
entitlements.limits: Some transactions still go through while locked (e.g. recurring adjustments, fees, system-downtime purchases). Usually primary cardholder only.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Typically, only primary cardholders or account managers can lock and unlock a card.

entitlements.name: CreditWise monitoring, FICO Score 8, dark web alerts
entitlements.limits: Free; must sign up for CreditWise. FICO Score 8 from TransUnion data; alerts on select TransUnion and Experian changes and dark web findings.
entitlements.source_excerpt: The credit score provided in CreditWise is a FICO Score 8 based on TransUnion data.

entitlements.name: Virtual card number
entitlements.limits: Not all customers eligible; identity check required; may not be available until about 30 days after opening.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Some customers will not be eligible to access a virtual card. If you are eligible, you must verify your identity

entitlements.name: No foreign transaction fee
entitlements.limits: Discover network acceptance abroad is narrower than Visa/Mastercard. Not confirmed on a live issuer page this check; the issuer FX-fee article now redirects to unrelated content.
